about: Plan 8.3: the performance gate (npm run perf:gate), Playwright + the browser's own PerformanceObserver metrics, since Lighthouse / LHCI is not in the lockfile. Levels: error fails the gate, warn is reported. Error thresholds are the runner level of decision 15.16 (20)/(21) (LCP ≈ 3500 ms, FCP ≈ 1200 ms) and are tightened by 8.1/8.2; `target` is the plan's goal, reported only, until the runner meets it.
